name: Trollkin (Sorcerer Bloodline)
body:
One of your ancestors was cursed by a troll matron, or contaminated by troll blood.

Class Skill(s)

Intimidate.

Bonus Spells

3rd—enlarge person, 5th—pouncing fury, 7th—blood rage, 9th—temporary graft, 11th—persistent vigor, 13th—giant form I, 15th—primal regression, 17th—rend body IV, 19th—regenerate.

Bonus Feats

Cleave, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness.

Bloodline Arcana

Though your size doesn’t change, you are considered as both your race and a troll (included the giant subtype) for all prerequisites. All healing spells heal you of +1 hit point per dice.

Bloodline Powers Your troll powers give you great resilience and healing abilities, though sometimes they negatively affect your rationality.

Claws (Su)

Starting at 1st level, you can grow claws as a free action. These claws are treated as natural weapons, allowing you to make two claw attacks as a full attack action using your full base attack bonus. Each of these attacks deals 1d4 points of damage plus your Strength modifier (1d3 if you are Small). At 5th level, these claws are considered magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming DR. At 7th level, the damage increases by one step to 1d6 points of damage (1d4 if you are Small). At 11th level, you gain the rend universal monster ability with your claws. You can use your claws for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Troll Fury (Ex)

At 3rd level, you gain a +1 natural armor bonus to AC and can rage as a barbarian for a number of rounds per day equal to your sorcerer level. You do not gain any rage powers from this power, though if you have rage powers from another class, you may use them with these rages. At 9th level, your natural armor bonus increases to +2, and at 15th level, to +4.

Unnatural Toughness (Ex)

At 9th level, you gain a +2 inherent bonus to your Constitution. This bonus increases to +4 at 13th level, and to +6 at 17th level.

Indestructible (Su)

At 15th level, you gain fast healing 5. You can heal a number of hit points per day equal to 5 x your sorcerer level with this ability.

Troll Monarch (Ex)

At 20th level, you become a true troll captain of legend. You gain darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, and scent. If you already have darkvision, its range increases to 90 feet. You also gain DR 5/–, and your fast healing ability is replaced with regeneration 5 (acid, fire).
